title: dynamicTank operation
description: A level-bearing storage tank of choupoCtrl / choupoSemiContinuous: a liquid holdup in a DECLARED vertical cylinder whose level integrates (or self-regulates) against a declared outflow. It reacts nothing (a `reaction` is refused by name -- the vessel with a reaction and a level is the variable-volume dynamicCSTR). The feed is the `in <stream>` of the unit and its `inlet {}` block (F, T, composition), the starting state the `initial {}` block (T, optional P, composition, and EITHER `level` OR `totalMoles`/`V`, never both); this `operation` block holds the geometry, the optional jacket and the outflow declaration (DynamicTank.cpp:63-135). No geometry and no outflow is assumed.

geometry.title: Vessel geometry
geometry.description: The vertical cylinder the level is measured in (VariableVolumeHoldup.cpp:52-72). Required: none is assumed; refused when absent. A level above `height` aborts the run as an overflow, refused rather than clamped.

shape.description: The one shape the vessel reads.

diameter.description: Inside diameter; the cross-section is pi D^2 / 4.

outflow.title: Outflow
outflow.description: The declared outflow (DynamicTank.cpp:80-107): `mode flow` (a manipulated molar flow F; the level integrates) or `mode valve` (a valve on the outlet; the level self-regulates). No default mode.

F.description: mode flow: the outflow, >= 0. A controller's actuator may overwrite it every step.

valve.description: mode valve: the valve block (VariableVolumeHoldup.cpp:149-160). Q = Cv x opening x sqrt(dP / rho), dP from the vessel pressure plus the liquid head to the downstream pressure.

UA.title: Jacket conductance
UA.description: U*A in W/K (raw SI). Heat to the holdup is UA (T_jacket - T). Defaults to 0: no jacket, adiabatic (DynamicTank.cpp:73).

T_jacket.title: Jacket temperature
T_jacket.description: Jacket fluid temperature. Defaults to the initial temperature of the holdup (no heat flows) (DynamicTank.cpp:74). A controller's actuator may overwrite it every step.
